heading: `distance.levenshtein()` built-in
text:
### `distance.levenshtein()` built-in [LNLS.3.6]

Any call to `distance.levenshtein(a, b)` ([LIMP.3.3.4]) is a compile error
(`DS_VALIDATE_NOLINSCAN_LEVENSHTEIN`) in a `linear_scan: false` file.

Rationale: Levenshtein edit distance is O(L × S) by the standard DP
algorithm.  L and S are slot-content lengths, not compile-time
constants; no bounded alternative exists.
